item.title: Week 10: Panthers at Saints
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NO -1.5 · O/U 48.5 | Model NO 45% vs. market 50% | On paper Carolina has the edge, led by its 1st-ranked defense in YAC over expected (-0.6 yards per catch) against New Orleans' 28th (-0.7), while New Orleans counters with red-zone scoring (11th, 59% TD rate) against Carolina's 29th-ranked defense (65% allowed).
